# Vocabulary

## Prefer

- "page" over "article" or "document"
- "space" for a group of pages
- "sign in" over "log in"

## Avoid

- "wiki" (it sounds technical to many of our readers)
- "Simply" or "just" in instructions

## Word rules

The exact rules live in `voice/terms.yaml`. This table is generated from it.

<!-- obks:terms -->
<!-- Generated by obks export from voice/terms.yaml. Edit that, not this block. -->
| Use | Instead of | Topic | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Acme Docs** | ~~AcmeDocs~~, ~~Acme docs~~, ~~ACME Docs~~ | product name | Spell the product name exactly; "Docs" alone only after first mention (exact capitalization) |
| **Acme Labs** | ~~ACME~~, ~~Acme labs~~, ~~AcmeLabs~~ | company name |  (exact capitalization) |
| **page** | ~~article~~ | product | Matches the words in the product |
| **knowledge base** | ~~wiki~~ |  | Wiki sounds technical to many of our readers |
| **sign in** | ~~log in~~, ~~login to~~ | product and support |  |
| _(never use)_ | ~~simply~~, ~~just~~ | instructions | It makes people feel bad when the step is not simple |
